scope: Source-specific records linked by identifiers; not a deduplicated worldwide drug count.

sources.name: FDA application and submission records
sources.limits: Original application approval dates are not presentation-specific approvals. Submission events retain their type and status.

sources.name: FDA NDC directory
sources.limits: Listing and marketing dates do not establish approval or safety withdrawal. Includes listed product categories as published.

sources.name: openFDA submitted label records
sources.limits: Full published endpoint snapshot, not all historical versions. Safety narrative sections are retained and indexed. SPL effective dates are not first-addition dates.

sources.name: FDA Orange Book presentations
sources.limits: NDA/ANDA presentations. Discontinued status is not proof of a safety withdrawal; historical before-1982 dates retain their qualifier.

sources.name: EMA human medicine report
sources.limits: EMA report scope; not all nationally authorised European medicines. Withdrawn applications and withdrawn authorisations remain distinct source statuses.

sources.name: Health Canada DPD: marketed, approved, dormant and cancelled
sources.limits: Includes source product classes. Status-history dates remain typed; cancellation is not automatically safety withdrawal. Company addresses and contact fields are excluded.

sources.name: PV Info captured FDA SrLC and EMA recommendations
sources.limits: Existing captured subset, not a full SrLC archive. Recommendation dates do not establish label implementation.

sources.name: DailyMed historical SPL versions
sources.limits: Available through Label Intelligence; all historical versions are not bulk-ingested in this repository.

sources.name: FDA Purple Book
sources.limits: Additional biologic coverage requires a separate verified connector.

sources.name: EMA Article 57 public data
sources.limits: National authorisation expansion is not yet loaded.

sources.name: TGA ARTG
sources.limits: Not ingested; no Australian coverage claimed.

sources.name: MHRA product information
sources.limits: Not ingested; no UK coverage claimed.

sources.name: PMDA drug information
sources.limits: Not ingested; Japanese-language identity and date mapping require a connector.
